item.title: Getting the Most from Percipio : Getting Started with Percipio: Navigation Q&A
item.description: Description: In this workshop, you will learn how to navigate the main dashboard, search for content, access assigned learning and track your progress. We’ll also walk through common questions users have and show you where to find help when needed. Whether you’re brand new or just need a refresher, this session will ensure you’re ready to make the most of Percipio. item.title: Seeking a Highly Motivated RPI Undergraduate or Master’s Student to Join a Research Project
item.description: We are seeking a highly motivated RPI undergraduate or master’s student to join a research project focused on developing optimization methods for collaborative school transportation planning. The position is available as a paid hourly research assistantship or for academic credit, depending on the student’s interests and eligibility. item.title: Upcoming Brief Carousel Signage Outages
item.description: Carousel Signage has notified RPI of two upcoming outages of the Carousel Signage website. During this time all signage will continue to play cached content, however the website will be unavailable briefly for a 10 minute period while the site is updated. Outage 1 - Tuesday August 18 at 5:30pm Outage 2 - Tuesday August 25 between 8pm and 10pm

item.title: TIAA Confidential Counseling (In-Person)
item.description: Date: Thursday, August 20, 2026 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM - A TIAA Financial Consultant will be available for one-on-one consultations on a broad range of retirement topics. Attend this upcoming event to help you become better informed and more confident about Rensselaer’s retirement plan benefits. Consultations will be conducted in 60 minute increments. To schedule your individual retirement counseling, please call TIAA at 1-800-732-8353 or online at https://www.tiaa.org/public/login/schedule-meeting

item.title: Heliocampus Fall 2026 Syllabus Available - Complete by September 10
item.description: The HelioCampus syllabus module is now available for faculty to access for the fall semester. Based on the requirements from the Provost’s office, faculty should have their syllabi published in HelioCampus by September 10, 2026. HelioCampus will publish all syllabi automatically on September 17, 2026.
item.author: Faculty and Staff

item.title: ISSS Town Hall: Duration of Status (D/S) Changes
item.description: ISSS is holding a Town Hall to share information about the recent regulatory change to Duration of Status (D/S) that affects individuals in F-1 and J-1 status and their dependents. This event is open to the campus community, and this session focus is on answering campus partner questions. Join us virtually on Thursday, August 20, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. Register here: https://tinyurl.com/RPI-DS-townhall-2
item.author: Faculty and Staff

item.title: Nominations are Open! RPI’s Annual Staff Awards
item.description:
You can now nominate a colleague or team whose contributions, creativity, dedication, and impact truly stand out! Take a moment to celebrate the people and teams who help RPI thrive through the Annual Staff Awards Program. Log in to Awardco to submit your nomination and recognize someone who makes a difference at RPI!

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
